name: DECAY LOOPS
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Tape loops that fall apart as they play
description: DECAY LOOPS turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a tape looper whose loops slowly disintegrate, after William Basinski's Disintegration Loops. It writes a phrase of chords or a slow figure, records it onto tape and plays it over and over. Each pass the tape wears: the highs roll off, dropouts open and grow, the pitch wobbles and the hiss rises, until only fragments are left. Before a loop is gone a fresh phrase is recorded on another layer and fades in, so it plays without end. Keys add notes to the next loop. Fourteen tape stocks and moods; the screen shows turning reels and the tape wearing away.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, and on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
